Cellect Biotechnology Ltd. (APOP) Analysts See $-0.30 EPS; Vident Investment Advisory Has Raised Its Cracker Barrel Old Ctry Stor (CBRL) Stake
May 18, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Analysts expect Cellect Biotechnology Ltd. (NASDAQ:APOP) to report $-0.30 EPS on June, 4.They anticipate $0.26 EPS change or 650.00% from last quarter’s $-0.04 EPS. After having $-0.16 EPS previously, Cellect Biotechnology Ltd.’s analysts see 87.50% EPS growth. The stock decreased 1.82% or $0.13 $7. About 13,863 shares traded. Cellect Biotechnology Ltd. (NASDAQ:APOP) has declined 42.02% downtrending. It has underperformed by 53.57% the S&P500.

The Vident Investment Advisory Llc holds 4,852 shares with $771,000 value, up from 2,660 last quarter. Cracker Barrel Old Ctry Stor now has $3.81B valuation. The stock increased 1.76% or $2.75 $158.85. About 241,309 shares traded. Cracker Barrel Old Country Store, Inc. (NASDAQ:CBRL) has risen 1.24% uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.31% the S&P500.
Cellect Biotechnology Ltd., a biotechnology company, focuses on developing technologies for the functional selection of stem cells in the field of regenerative medicine and stem cell therapies in Israel. The company has market cap of $45.57 million. It is developing the Apotainer selection kit, a shelf stem cell selection kit, based on its Powered by Cellect technology platform for allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation procedures for patients suffering from hematological malignancies. It currently has negative earnings.
